name: code-server
description: Run VS Code in your browser, on your server. Sign in with the auto-generated password below.

configFields.label: Login password
configFields.help: Auto-generated. Required to sign in. Uses PASSWORD (plaintext) rather than HASHED_PASSWORD, which expects an argon2 digest.

connection.title: Sign in to code-server
connection.description: VS Code in the browser. Sign in with the generated password below.

guide.intro: A full VS Code editor running on your server, reachable from any browser.

outputs.label: Editor
outputs.help: Opens the browser IDE. Sign in with the password below.

firstLogin.note: Your whole home directory is the persisted volume, so files, extensions and settings all survive a redeploy. The editor opens /home/coder by default.
